system.Text:
When __you journey along a known route, and one day blends into the next__, roll +supply.

On a __strong hit__, you reach your destination and the situation favors you. Take +1 momentum.

On a __weak hit__, you complete the journey, but face a cost or complication. Choose one or more.

  * You took longer than expected.
  * You pressed on through pain, sickness, or weariness: @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.ironswornmoves.fdb51ee928b4fca2]{Endure Harm}.
  * You suffered under the burden of foul weather, worries, or fearful locations: @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.ironswornmoves.e09e2fc8bb709320]{Endure Stress}.
  * You wasted resources.
  * You face a complication or hazard at the destination. Envision what you find (@Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.ironswornmoves.aba3e44b7e810c0f]{Ask the Oracle} if unsure).

On a __miss__, you are waylaid by a dire threat and must @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.ironswornmoves.c10d64f58dd8c5bf]{Pay the Price}. If you overcome this obstacle, you may push on safely to your destination.
